items.title: Government approves major expansion and modernization of forensic infrastructure across India
items.summary: Press Information Bureau: National Forensic Infrastructure Enhancement Scheme approved with allocations for CFSL/FSL upgrades, mobile forensic vans, DNA and cyber forensics capacity-building.

items.title: FORENSIC LABS AND FORENSIC INFRASTRUCTURE: Upgradation plan and new CFSLs
items.summary: PIB release detailing the National Forensic Infrastructure Enhancement Scheme, new CFSL buildings and the e-Forensics platform linking laboratories nationwide.

items.title: Supreme Court lays down nationwide norms for handling DNA evidence
items.summary: Landmark directions emphasize chain of custody, packaging, and transport timelines for DNA samples in criminal cases to ensure evidentiary reliability.

items.title: High Court orders DNA tests on mortal remains of seafarer killed in Gulf attack
items.summary: Mumbai High Court directs DNA verification for skeletal remains sent to state FSLs to establish identity after conflicting postmortem documentation.

items.title: Madras High Court orders fresh autopsy after independent forensic review
items.summary: Court found discrepancies between initial postmortem report and its video record; directed re-examination and SIT probe in a suspicious death.

items.title: AIIMS conducts second postmortem in high-profile Twisha Sharma case
items.summary: AIIMS team returned for further testing; second autopsy report differs from initial findings, with forensic samples sent for additional analysis.

items.title: Ahmedabad cold case solved after 34 years using DNA profiling
items.summary: Crime branch and FSL investigators used forensic DNA to identify remains and link suspects in a decades-old disappearance and murder.

items.title: Government inaugurates new CFSL building in Kolkata as part of modernization plan
items.summary: New Central Forensic Science Laboratory inaugurated; regional coverage and equipment upgrades to serve multiple states in the eastern region.

items.title: Budget allocations and MHA directives accelerate forensic modernization and mobile van deployment
items.summary: Union budget 2026–27 and an MHA directive push for district-level labs, mobile forensic vans and faster DNA/toxicology reporting across states.

items.title: National cyber forensics capacity expands; nearly 2,500 personnel trained under cybercrime roadmap
items.summary: Law enforcement personnel trained in digital forensic techniques, with new national cyber forensic labs and emphasis on indigenous tools and MeitY initiatives.

items.title: India to host INTERPOL Digital Forensic Experts meeting at NFSU
items.summary: NFSU to host international meeting of digital forensic experts, highlighting India's growing role in cross-border forensic cooperation and training.

items.title: Mobile forensic vans deployed widely to preserve scene evidence
items.summary: Regional reporting on how mobile forensic units equipped with DNA sampling, digital forensics kits and narcotics testing are improving evidence integrity at crime scenes.

items.title: Gujarat man allegedly poisoned and buried; DNA testing ordered
items.summary: Police investigations uncovered poisoning and burial; remains sent for DNA profiling at state forensic lab to establish identity and link suspects.

items.title: Forensic medicine: how postmortems and toxicology resolve disputed causes of death
items.summary: Explainer coverage describing the role of forensic pathology, toxicology and lab analysis in differentiating causes of death and supporting judicial processes.

items.title: Videotaped postmortem and forensic evidence used in investigation of suspicious death
items.summary: Covering a case where transparent postmortem procedures and forensic sample preservation led to renewed investigation and judicial oversight.

items.title: Global: New forensic DNA technique speeds identification in disaster victim cases
items.summary: International research report describing an improved DNA profiling method with implications for mass-disaster victim identification and cross-border forensic collaboration.

items.title: Global: Advances in digital forensics tools for memory and mobile analysis
items.summary: Industry coverage of new tools for mobile device and memory forensics, including AI-assisted triage and court-ready reporting features.

items.title: Supreme Court clarifies admissibility standards for electronic and forensic evidence
items.summary: Judicial commentary and coverage summarizing recent Supreme Court guidance on reliability, chain of custody and corroboration standards for expert forensic testimony.

items.title: Indian policy: MeitY and Make-in-India push for indigenous cyber-forensic tools
items.summary: Policy coverage on MeitY encouraging adoption and development of indigenous tools for digital forensics to ensure data sovereignty and operational independence.

items.title: Global: Forensic toxicology methods updated for emerging synthetic poisons
items.summary: Technical report on adaptation of toxicology laboratory protocols to detect new synthetic toxins and improve detection windows.

items.title: Court allows late-stage DNA testing in circumstantial case to ensure scientific justice
items.summary: Delhi High Court permitted fresh DNA tests during final arguments, underscoring the courts' willingness to integrate forensic science to achieve just outcomes.

items.title: Global: New inter-operable forensic data platforms accelerate lab workflows
items.summary: Coverage on national forensic data platforms that link labs, police and courts to reduce backlog and accelerate evidence turnaround.
